Our formula for success is to hire exceptional people, encourage their ideas and reward their results.

As a Trade Support Intern, you will gain hands-on experience at the intersection of trading, technology, and operations. Through your contributions to Trade Support, you will help improve the tools, workflows, and processes that keep our trading desks running effectively.

How you will make an impact…

- Work on refactoring and improving existing scripts within the trade support team.

- Support trade capture across the full range of desk products, including futures, futures options, equities, equity options, and index options.

- Provide operational and technical support to the firm's FICC trading desks.

- Assist with tool functionality and testing to support front-end operations.

- Contribute to reporting and data analysis.

What you will bring to the team…

- Are pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s in Computer Science and have an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028

- Proficiency in Python programming

- Experience with version control systems (GitHub)

- Demonstrated experience with development work or similar technical projects

- Work authorization in the United States without the need for sponsorship

What to expect during the internship…

- Meaningful projects: You’ll receive a challenging project to complete during your time here. Each project, advised by a member of your team, promotes a comprehensive learning experience and provides you with meaningful work experience.

- Community: Throughout the summer, we host a variety of educational, social and team-building activities to foster friendship and camaraderie.

- Housing: DRW provides fully furnished apartments located close to the office –making your morning commute as easy as possible.

- Mentorship: You’ll build a professional relationship with an experienced mentor in your field. Mentors and mentees meet to discuss goals, challenges and professional development and explore the city together at our mentor outings.

- Education: As technology continues to drive the trading industry forward, both in terms of new products and transaction methods, the future will present us with unique opportunities and challenges. To prepare you for how technology will continue to impact trading’s future landscape, you will complete an options course framed from a developer’s standpoint to help you visualize how your technology solutions will be used in real time. As the trading industry continually evolves, both in terms of new products and transaction methods, the future will present us with unique opportunities and challenges.

DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

The annual base salary for this position is $110,000.

Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role

Hadrian is looking for a Data Science/ Data Engineer Intern to join the team building the data backbone of our autonomous factory. Every machine, part, and process on our floor generates data, and how well we move, model, and interpret that data determines how fast we can scale. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and analysts on real production data- from the pipelines that move machine telemetry and quality records into our warehouse to the models and analyses that shape how we run the factory. This is a hands-on role where your work will ship, and your contributions will directly influence operational decisions at Hadrian.

What You'll Do

- Build and maintain data pipelines that move machine, production, quality, and program data from the factory floor into our warehouse

- Model and structure datasets that engineering, operations, and quality teams rely on for daily decision-making

- Analyze production data to surface insights on throughput, capacity, cycle time, yield, and machine utilization

- Develop dashboards, metrics, and reporting that improve visibility into factory performance and program status

- Prototype statistical or machine learning approaches for problems like anomaly detection, demand forecasting, or process optimization

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including operations, program management, and quality to translate open questions into measurable analyses

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code and participate in code reviews

- Surface data quality issues and contribute to discussions on how we instrument and govern our data

What We're Looking For

- Current university student pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Math, Engineering, or a related field, with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028

- Proficiency in Python and SQL

- Familiarity with data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, or cloud data warehouses

- Working knowledge of statistics and the ability to turn a messy dataset into a defensible conclusion

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work through ambiguous technical challenges

- Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain analysis to non-technical partners

- Strong attention to detail and follow-through

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving, highly ambiguous environment

- Willingness to work on-site in Los Angeles, CA

- Internships are available for our Fall 2026, Spring 2027, and Summer 2027 cohorts. Indicate your preferred term(s) when applying.

What Will Set You Apart

- Prior internship or project experience building production data pipelines or shipping analysis that changed a decision

- Experience with orchestration or transformation tooling

- Exposure to time-series, sensor, or telemetry data

- Interest in manufacturing systems, automation, or industrial software

What You'll Gain

- Hands-on experience building data infrastructure and analysis for a high-growth, mission-driven industrial company

- Direct involvement with real production data, not sample datasets or side projects

- Exposure to the full path from raw factory signal to operational decision

- A front-row seat to how Hadrian is transforming aerospace and defense manufacturing through software, automation, and data

Compensation

For this role, the target hourly range is $46.15 - $50.71

This reflects the lowest to highest hourly rate we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this intern position at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range is subject to change. An intern's hourly rate within this range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to relevant education, prior experience, skills, geographic location, and the nature of the internship assignment.

Intern Benefits

Housing support may be available based on business need.

Provide technical support to the Bosch water electrolysis research team for electrolysis cell testing and characterization. The intern responsibility includes assembling test rigs, operating/monitoring electrolysis test benches, processing and interpretating testing results, and carrying out physical analysis. Additional responsibilities may include further development of testing methodology and/or further development of lab scale test capability.

- Experience with electrochemical testing equipment.
- Familiar with data processing and interpretation.
- Be enthusiastic and able to collaborate in a team environment.
- Curious and passionate about learning and exploring.
- Ability to translate technical concepts into simple to understand, communicable ideas.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with advanced characterization techniques, e.g., SEM, XRF, XRD, gas MS, etc.
- Experience with script coding, data analysis automation and interpretation.
- Publications to demonstrate past work in the hydrogen energy conversion field.

The U.S. base salary range for this intern position is $41.00/hr - $55.00/hr. Enterprise Intelligence Summer Intern

Want to spend your summer building practical data, analytics, and AI solutions that solve real business problems? Motion Industries is looking for a Summer Intern to join our Enterprise Intelligence team and help us explore how data agents, dashboards, automation, and modern analytics tools can make information easier to find, understand, and use.

This internship is a great fit for a college student who is curious about data, business intelligence, AI, and technology-driven problem solving. You do not need to be an expert on day one. We are looking for someone who enjoys learning, asks thoughtful questions, communicates clearly, and wants hands-on experience with meaningful projects.

What You’ll Work On

- Help build and test data agents, analytical assistants, or AI-enabled workflows.

- Create prototype dashboards, reports, data summaries, or visualizations.

- Use tools such as Power BI, SQL, Excel, Python, or similar technologies to explore data and share insights.

- Document business questions, data definitions, test results, and user feedback.

- Work with team members to understand how analytics and AI can support better decisions across the business.

What You’ll Learn

- How companies use data, analytics, and AI to solve business problems.

- How dashboards, data products, and data agents are designed and tested.

- How to turn a business question into a practical analytics solution.

- How teams collaborate on technology projects in a professional environment.

- How responsible AI, data quality, and trusted information matter in enterprise work.

Who We’re Looking For

- A college student pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, MIS, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.

- Someone interested in data, analytics, automation, AI, business intelligence, or technology.

- Someone with exposure to SQL, Python, Power BI, Excel, databases, dashboards, or data visualization through coursework, projects, internships, or personal learning.

- A clear communicator who can explain what they are working on and ask good questions.

- A dependable teammate who is organized, curious, and excited to learn.

Why Motion

Motion Industries is a leading industrial distribution company where technology, data, and business operations come together. As part of the Enterprise Intelligence team, you’ll get exposure to real projects, supportive teammates, and practical experience with analytics and AI capabilities that help people make better decisions.

About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About the Supply Chain Business Operations Team

The Supply Chain BizOps team’s mission is to ensure supply continuity and cost efficiency while enabling Zipline’s growth. The team also builds business intelligence capabilities that inform strategic decisions across product, production, and operations.

The team is responsible for strategic planning, high-priority program management, executive communications, and digital transformation. Through strong strategic thinking and execution excellence, team members lead cross-functional and cross-commodity initiatives that drive measurable impact across cost, quality, and supply ramp-up.

The Role

The role sits at the intersection of data analytics, strategy design, market intelligence, and digital transformation. The role will partner with business analysts and strategists to identify opportunities to evolve Zipline Supply Chain, develop and execute strategies, and operationalize digital workflows. These efforts will improve Zipline’s unit economics and support its long-term growth.

What You'll Do

- Conduct due diligence on the latest best-practice supply chain operations

- Manage programs to achieve Supply Chain goals and own reporting

- Build business intelligence to inform Supply Chain operations excellence, cost control, supply continuity improvement

- Strategize Zipline Supply Chain operations excellence and drive implementation

- Create enablement materials that help software development team develop future digital solutions

- Build digital tools to measure and oversee KPIs for Supply Chain

What You'll Bring

- Pursuing a degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, or related field

- Strong analytical skills with experience to analyze data and generate insights

- Interest in supply chain excellence, process improvement, digital transformation, and AI-enabled solutions

- Experience with SQL, Python, Power BI/Tableau, automation tools (coding experience is a plus)

- Ability to build simple MVPs/prototypes, test ideas quickly, and iterate based on feedback

- Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams

What Else You Should Know

Our internships are full-time positions, in-person at our South San Francisco office. We will host our Summer 2027 interns from May/June to August/September 2027.

Candidates are limited to three (3) applications within a 30-day period.

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities.

Zipline is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your point of contact at Zipline know if you require any accommodations throughout your interview process.

Voluntary Self-Identification

For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.

As set forth in Zipline ’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As an Intern with the Yield Technology RAM group at Micron, you will support process engineering, Real-Time Defect Analysis (RDA), and Metrology activities in a semiconductor manufacturing environment! This internship is designed for a motivated student who is interested in learning how advanced memory products are developed, measured, analyzed, and improved. You will work alongside engineers and technicians to gain hands-on exposure to fab operations, equipment workflows, data analysis, recipe support, and cross-functional problem solving.

During this internship, you will gain exposure to semiconductor manufacturing, process development, defect analysis, metrology techniques, and data-driven problem solving. Intern assignments may include supporting recipe workflows, analyzing measurement or defect data, improving documentation, assisting with operational metrics, and contributing to a focused project that supports Yield Technology objectives. The ideal candidate is a curious, collaborative student who wants to learn and communicate ideas clearly. They will engage in significant technical work within a high-impact manufacturing environment.

Responsibilities:

- Complete assigned internship onboarding, safety training, certifications, and learning events to build foundational knowledge of Micron systems, fab operations, RDA, and Metrology workflows.
- Support Fab 4 Process Development Engineering, Process Integration, RDA, and Metrology teams by assisting with data collection, basic analysis, tool support activities, and documentation.
- Review workflows, measurement setup, and basic equipment/process support under the guidance of tenured engineers and technicians.
- Provide supervised support for SEM, defect review, and incoming fab requests, including tracking request status, understanding queue priorities, and helping summarize results.
- Assist with analysis and support for Fab 4 Yield Engineering part types, including DRAM and emerging memory development activities, as assigned.
- Connect with engineers and team members regarding requests, priorities, observations, and follow-up actions in a clear and professional manner.
- Contribute to an internship project employing Artificial Intelligence to identify and implement improvements in RDA, Metrology, process improvement, data analysis, automation, or recipe workflow support; summarize key findings and present project outcomes to the team.

Minimum Qualifications:

- Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Data Science, or a related technical field. Cannot graduate prior to September 2027.
- Basic coursework or interest in semiconductor processing, manufacturing, materials characterization, metrology, defect analysis, or related technical areas.
- Ability to approach technical problems with curiosity, ask questions, collect relevant information, and help develop data-based recommendations using AI proficiency or AI‑enabled ways of working where applicable.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools such as PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and OneNote; interest in learning data analysis, automation, and AI-enabled productivity tools.
- Ability to work safely in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and follow all fab, cleanroom, quality, and safety requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Ability to prioritize tasks, manage time, and work both independently and as part of a team.
- Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, with the ability to summarize technical information clearly.
- Experience, coursework, or project exposure related to semiconductor Metrology, RDA, SEM, data analysis, process control, statistics, Python, Claude, MATLAB, JMP, or Excel is preferred but not required.
- A growth mindset, attention to detail, willingness to learn from mentors, and passion for solving technical challenges.

As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.
